title: SAGIP DEVELOPMENT AND VALIDATION EVIDENCE
subtitle: Evidence labels describe what has been demonstrated. They are not maturity scores and do not collapse automated, device, backend, and field evidence into one status.

stages.title: Requirements and Architecture
stages.detail: Canonical design, delivery semantics, protocols, field acceptance, and responder operations are documented.

stages.title: Core SOS and Delivery Pipeline
stages.detail: Durable local creation, immutable SGP1 preparation, direct delivery, retry, deduplication, and ACK logic have automated coverage.

stages.title: Android Runtime and Lifecycle
stages.detail: Instrumentation and foreground-service behavior have physical-device evidence. This does not prove two-phone RF custody.

stages.title: Live Backend
stages.detail: Live PostgreSQL migrations/runtime and a concurrent duplicate-ingestion scenario have direct backend evidence.

stages.title: BLE Store-Carry-Forward
stages.detail: Protocol/runtime code exists, but end-to-end custody across two physical phones remains unverified.

stages.title: Security v2 Components
stages.detail: SQLCipher and SGP2/HPKE code/tests exist. SGP1 remains normal emission; representative SQLCipher device migration/recovery qualification is still required.

stages.title: Complete Two-Phone Acceptance Loop
stages.detail: Required: A offline → BLE custody B → B online → backend → responder ACK → physical SGA1 return to A.

stages.title: Production Emergency-Service Deployment
stages.detail: Production signing, encryption/key distribution, field acceptance, and operational service gates must be satisfied before production claims.
